dict.string: Obligations reads your contacts so the assistant can turn phone numbers and email addresses into names. Names are sent to your own server over Tailscale and nowhere else.

Obligations reads your reminders so the ones you tick close the matching task, and keeps a list called Obligations in step with what you owe. It never touches your other lists, never deletes, and never sets an alert.

Obligations sends messages you have approved in the chat interface, and only to people already in a recent conversation. It never sends anything you have not approved.
